exposure: Maternal clinical conditions (abdominal pain, abdominal tenderness, vaginal bleeding)
cohort: 154 pregnant patients with gestational age ≥23 weeks who presented after blunt abdominal trauma
finding: The incidence of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including preterm delivery, placental abruption, fetal demise, and NICU admission, was low following blunt abdominal trauma.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was 44% (68/154) in the study cohort.
